data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: let me first say that i do believe that climate change is a problem. let me also say that it has been exaggerated severely and that we''re going through a climate cycle which is what always happens; highs and lows, and i don't think there is anything at all to worry about. ASSISTANT:

Climate change is a complex issue and there is no single or simple explanation for it. Many scientists agree that climate change is occurring and that human activities are contributing to it. The exact impact of climate change on any given region or species is difficult to predict and will vary. It is important to be aware of the potential impacts of climate change and take action to reduce the risks.
